title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Real Estate Offer - RealEstateListing
description: A real estate listing representing an offer for a property -- sale, rent, or transfer (edintinm:RealEstateListing). NOTE: the source ontology's own generated ontology.ttl declares this class as subClassOf a class named 'Error1' in an 'org.semanticweb.owlapi/error#' namespace -- an OWL-API tooling artifact from a malformed-axiom placeholder, not a real superclass. Ignored here; not modeled as any kind of inheritance.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RealEstateListing'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item, derived from the listing's own title (dct:title).

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the listing in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'LIST-003'.

propertyType.description: Property. The type of real estate property in the listing, from this ontology's own Uso controlled vocabulary (edintinm:propertyType). NOTE: the property's own comment claims it 'reuses the Spanish Cadastre use vocabulary', but the source ontology actually ships its own separate KOS file (kos/inmobiliaria-uso.ttl) with different, Spanish, lowercase-hyphenated values (vivienda, local-comercial, oficina, nave-industrial, solar) -- not the same value set as edint-catastro's own published Uso vocabulary (Residential, Industrial, Offices, ...). Modeled here using this ontology's own actually-published KOS values, not the ones its comment claims to reuse; see standard-metadata.yaml.

transactionType.description: Property. Type of real estate transaction -- sale, rent, or transfer -- from the TransactionType controlled vocabulary (edintinm:transactionType). Values kept in the source's own Spanish notation (Venta/Alquiler/Traspaso) rather than translated, since that's the actual published vocabulary.

isActive.description: Property. Whether the listing is currently active (edintinm:isActive).

refersToCadastralEntity.description: Relationship. The cadastral entity (edint-catastro's CadastralParcel for land-only sales, or CadastralProperty for built properties) this listing corresponds to (edintinm:refersToCadastralEntity). NOTE: the source ontology's own real example data models the target cadastral entity with an entirely different, informal property shape (a fictional 'catastro:' vocabulary with properties like referenceCatastral/hasAddress/roadName) that does not match edint-catastro's own real, already-translated schema (hasPropertyReference/hasAddress->callejero:Portal/etc.) -- the example's cadastral-entity shape is not reused here; this Relationship is expected to point at the real edint-catastro CadastralParcel/CadastralProperty entities instead.
